name: 9661-visionprefill-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1 -- single GPU, single process
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 256 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat: three distinct 1920x1080 gradient JPEGs at quality 85 plus 512 text tokens per request, 32 output tokens with ignore_eos. A request is ~8,600 tokens of which 8,073 are vision.
purpose: A photo analysis assistant captioning three full-resolution images per request for sixteen concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped on read, and a
# dropped block means the engine runs without something this file declares. Environment variables
# cannot live here; the one this setup needs is in configs/tuned.yaml.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# Must stay above one request's ~8,600 tokens: this commit's H100 default of 8192 would split
# every request across scheduler steps, and a split request with configs/tuned.yaml's embedding
# memo off runs its image stage once per chunk. The two settings are one decision.
chunked-prefill-size: 16384

disable-radix-cache: true
